name: Ringu: Infinity
original_name: リング インフィニティ
source:
Players control a character who has watched Sadako's cursed videotape and has seven days to make decisions that will impact his or her life and potential death during this period. The game has multiple endings that are dependent on the players' choices.

Ring Infinity was an early supporter of downloadable content ("DLC") via the WonderGate function. Players were able to download additional scenarios where they were able to play through the events of the game from a different point of view.

Edited from the Ring [url=https://thering.fandom.com/wiki/Ring:_Infinity]Wiki[/url]
translation:
玩家操纵的角色看过贞子的诅咒录像带，必须在七天内作出决定，而这些选择将影响角色在此期间的生死。游戏设有多个结局，取决于玩家的选择。

《Ring Infinity》较早通过WonderGate功能支持可下载内容（DLC）。玩家可以下载追加篇章，从不同视角重新经历游戏中的事件。

编译自《午夜凶铃》[url=https://thering.fandom.com/wiki/Ring:_Infinity]维基[/url]
